name: Teen Fellows
what_you_do: A 15 month program about architecture and design. Fellows do a six week summer session, take fall and spring terms, and finish with a paid second-summer internship.
who_can_apply: Students going into 10th, 11th or 12th grade at a high school in Chicago or nearby who can do the whole program. Students from farther away can apply. They are picked based on need and on whether they have similar programs near home.
pay_detail: Free to join. Fellows earn a stipend (amount not stated) and a paid internship in the last summer (rate not stated).
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 round is closed. The page says applications for Summer 2027 to Summer 2028 open in November. Last deadline was March 31.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application linked on the Teen Fellows page when it opens. Questions: teens@architecture.org.
notes: The 2027 deadline is not posted. The internship is paid, so ask the program about Illinois working papers for under 16. The page does not say. Watch the center's newsletter for the opening.
